svg.title: The serviceable line
svg.desc: Five layers, five lines. Findable, Selectable, Integrable, Operable and Fixable, each drawn to a different length between "carried by your customers and their AI" and "your people step in, or the customer is lost", and each one still moving outward. A point of view by Etgar Bonar.
